proposals.existing_description: Concatenate two or more components in order. Multiple values produce the Cartesian product of component values. Components follow inherited source casting rules when a string conversion is required; incompatible values produce an error. A missing or nonexistent component yields the inherited source status; Error, Incomplete, Not Collected, and Not Applicable statuses are not silently converted to strings.
proposals.proposed_description: Concatenate at least two ordered component expressions, taking the Cartesian product of multivalued components; native casting and unavailable-component status mappings require explicit confirmation.
proposals.impact: The syntax and Cartesian-product rule are documented, but inherited source casting/status language is not a self-contained native conversion/result contract; return typing is not encoded at the function node.

before_after_examples.before: Two string literals are structurally valid; source-status words and incompatible conversions are delegated to inherited rules.
before_after_examples.after: String-literal shape remains valid; casting and unavailable-component behavior remain owner decisions, not silently adopted legacy defaults.

proposals.existing_description: Capture text from each input string using the first capturing group. The source regex dialect and first-match behavior are retained; inputs with no capture group or no match produce an empty string under the inherited function contract.
proposals.proposed_description: Extract the first capture from each input string; confirm the native regex dialect, no-match rule and status mapping before treating inherited behavior as normative.
proposals.impact: The current wording does not provide the explicit native meaning or boundary needed by an author or implementer.

proposals.existing_description: Remove duplicate scalar values from one expression or from multiple ordered component populations. Multiple components are flattened in source order before first-occurrence deduplication; duplicates and diagnostic statuses are preserved. Record data is not a supported transformation operand.
proposals.proposed_description: Remove duplicate scalar values from the input; equality, ordering and unavailable-value propagation require an explicit native contract.
proposals.impact: The existing example embeds an Object-reference wrapper through an open Object shape; a minimal literal example avoids implying supported reference syntax. Equality/order/status wording still needs native review.
